assembly.inputs: Approved component drawings, dimensions and assembly sequence.
assembly.semantics: A bracket, post and screw progress from separated parts to an assembled fixture. Keep one orthographic view and constant component dimensions.
assembly.review_requirements: Mechanical owner checks order, mating surfaces, tools and safety instructions before real assembly.
assembly.external_consumer: Provide product-specific tolerances, fastener torque and safety instructions; verify printed scale.
assembly.output_constraints: 96x96 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; cards

process.inputs: Approved process model, stage descriptions and scientific references.
process.semantics: A simplified water cycle: reservoir, upward vapor, cloud condensation, falling rain. Illustrations are symbolic, not a fluid simulation.
process.review_requirements: Subject-matter educator must check causal order, labels, omissions and audience suitability.
process.external_consumer: Supply curricular sources and expert content review; embed the exported page in the lesson.
process.output_constraints: 96x96 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; cards, browser

configurator.inputs: Product front view, palette swatches and approved variant differences.
configurator.semantics: The same front orthographic mug with only the approved glaze color changing. Preserve viewpoint, handle geometry and body dimensions.
configurator.review_requirements: Check identical silhouette/viewpoint and ensure only glaze differs; match physical color separately.
configurator.external_consumer: Wire selections to real SKU data and approved product imagery; browser selection alone is not commerce integration.
configurator.output_constraints: 96x96 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; browser, cards

flipbook.inputs: Ordered motion frames, target print size and intended viewing direction.
flipbook.semantics: A single ball bounces vertically through twelve ordered drawings with a fixed diameter and ground baseline.
flipbook.review_requirements: Check frame order, constant ball diameter, retained vertical displacement and physical test assembly.
flipbook.external_consumer: Print at 100%, cut, bind in order or assemble slit cylinder; physically test rotation speed.
flipbook.output_constraints: 64x64 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; flipbook, browser

communication.inputs: User-approved vocabulary, accessible descriptions and pictograms.
communication.semantics: Readable cup, bed and raised-hand pictograms, with matching descriptions and still alternatives. No clinical validation is implied.
communication.review_requirements: Check recognition, descriptions, contrast and personal/cultural suitability with intended users.
communication.external_consumer: Fit vocabulary and access method to the user; external assistive app integration and clinical assessment are separate.
communication.output_constraints: 96x96 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; board, browser, cards

perception.inputs: Condition definitions, source images, trial design and intended frame durations.
perception.semantics: Equal-diameter disks translate through the same positions; the controlled difference is luminance contrast.
perception.review_requirements: Check size/position equality and intended condition differences; review study design and ethics where applicable.
perception.external_consumer: Use a calibrated display and measured onset timing, randomization and experiment software. Ordinary browser timing is not laboratory precision.
perception.output_constraints: 64x64 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; stimuli, browser

regression.inputs: Fixture geometry and expected pixels, codec-specific reconstruction tolerances.
regression.semantics: Deterministic graphics fixtures: partial alpha edges, transparent holes, detached details and color-coded frame order. Fixtures only.
regression.review_requirements: Inspect compositor backgrounds and compare decoded pixels; GIF binary alpha is intentionally lossy.
regression.external_consumer: Import these labeled fixtures into the target compositor and record renderer/codec versions; no live compositor is exercised here.
regression.output_constraints: 64x64 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; browser, gif, webp, stimuli

cursor.inputs: Ordered cursor frames, integer hotspot and per-frame durations.
cursor.semantics: A pixel pointer with fixed hotspot at (4,4) and a six-frame activity marker. Keep pointer geometry stable.
cursor.review_requirements: Check hotspot alignment, pointer legibility and animation at actual size on light/dark backgrounds.
cursor.external_consumer: Load the Xcursor file in an Xcursor-capable consumer or adapt the local page; OS cursor settings are never changed.
cursor.output_constraints: 32x32 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; cursor, browser

protocol.inputs: State/event table, legal transitions, cancellation and timeout policy.
protocol.semantics: A sender/receiver protocol progresses from idle through request, acknowledgment and done; timeout leads to fault. Events must follow legal transitions.
protocol.review_requirements: Protocol owner checks event legality, priority, interruption and completion behavior against the actual algorithm.
protocol.external_consumer: Connect real protocol events after reviewing concurrency and failure semantics; this is an illustrative local consumer.
protocol.output_constraints: 96x96 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; browser, cards

craft.inputs: Palette, grid dimensions, motif source and physical material pitch.
craft.semantics: Grid-aligned rosette and diamond motifs in a named four-color palette for bead or embroidery planning.
craft.review_requirements: Check grid dimensions, palette mapping, symbol readability and practical construction with a swatch.
craft.external_consumer: Choose actual bead/thread colors, pitch and technique; the pack is a planning source, not a validated stitch instruction.
craft.output_constraints: 24x24 transparent cells; explicit ordered frames; craft
